acceptance: git log distinguishes a waived commit from a bypassed one
A lane change to commentaudit or commitgate is flagged as a signal-dir change
operating-policy.md, CLAUDE.md and the commit gate state one pure-docs rule

consumed.resolution: The attestation records review_waiver (comment-only, omitted when empty so the golden holds) and ship's reviewTrailer emits Review-waived: comment-only, so git log tells a waived commit from a bypassed one; commentaudit and commitgate joined scopedelta.signalDirs; the pure-docs rule is the gate's (both capabilities, one code-review-simplify pass covers them, architecture review optional), now stated in CLAUDE.md and operating-policy.md (ADR-0115; operator to confirm).

fix: (m4) An attestation field plus a trailer, with a golden test showing the field is absent when empty and a ship test showing the trailer. (m5) Add the two dirs to signalDirs, with a test that a lane diff touching them is flagged. (docs) Decide the pure-docs rule with the operator, then change the gate, or the two docs, to match.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: Console-commit traceability and a latent gaming surface on the comment-only proof; the loop is not affected.
summary: Deferred from the architect's review of batch 0 of the comment-reduction workstream (2026-09-26, APPROVE-WITH-MINOR). (m4) A waived commit and a --bypass-commit-gate commit look the same in git log: neither carries a Reviewed-by trailer. Add an optional review_waiver field to the attestation, omitted when empty so the byte-layout golden holds. Have ship's reviewedByTrailer emit `Review-waived: comment-only` for it. (m5) commentaudit decides whether review is skipped, so it is now judging apparatus: a wrong 'true' from Equivalent skips review. Add go/internal/commentaudit/ and go/internal/commitgate/ to scopedelta.signalDirs (go/internal/scopedelta/gaming.go), so a lane cannot loosen the directive pattern as ordinary code. (docs) operating-policy.md says pure-docs diffs may skip the simplifier, CLAUDE.md says they may skip the fleet, and the commit gate requires both reviewers for a docs-only change. Pick one rule and make all three agree.
title: Commit-gate comment waiver follow-ups: record the waiver in the attestation, guard the proof code as judging apparatus, and settle the pure-docs review policy
